name: Lightfused Mana Lily
tooltip:
Lightfused Mana Lily
5 yd range
2.5 sec cast
Another recent offshoot species, mana lily is a new variant of mageroyal. The latent magic present in the Quel'Thalas region has seeped into the mana lily, giving them potent properties for crafting.

If you're ever gathering around bodies of water, you can expect to find mana lilies somewhere nearby.

A strange light has begun to afflict the herbs growing within Quel'Thalas. They grow large and golden, reminiscent of the Sunwell itself, but twisted somehow. Gathering these herbs will release motes of holy energy that sear if caught, but yield additional resources.

Discovery: Midnight Gathering Nodes
